KrakenLabs

Senior Product Designer

Brooklyn, NY · Hybrid (3 days) Full-time · Senior level Posted: April 25, 2026

Why KrakenLabs

KrakenLabs is a 28-person team shipping a new generation of creative tools for game-design studios. Our product is used by over 200 studios, including 6 of the top 25 indie publishers worldwide.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to lead the design of our flagship desktop application. You'll work directly with our design lead and product team to drive both day-to-day design execution and our long-term design system.

You will

  • Lead end-to-end design for a major product surface (3-month rotations)
  • Establish and maintain our design-system fundamentals (Figma + tokens)
  • Partner with engineering on motion, micro-interactions, and visual polish
  • Run user research alongside our research lead (6 sessions/quarter min.)
  • Mentor 2 mid-level designers
  • Contribute to our hiring loops

You bring

  • 5+ years of product-design experience, ideally on desktop or creative tools
  • Strong portfolio with 2-3 deep case studies
  • Mastery of Figma, including variables, components, and design tokens
  • Experience with motion design (Framer, After Effects, or similar)
  • Track record collaborating closely with engineers
  • You enjoy the creative-tools space and have opinions about it

Bonus

  • Experience designing for game-design or creative-pro audiences
  • Public speaking or writing about design
  • Front-end engineering ability (React or Web Components)

Compensation

$170,000 - $215,000 base, plus equity, plus comprehensive benefits. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role at this time.
